title: An MBene-based colloidal electrolyte for high depth-of-discharge and energy-density 2 Ah-scale Zn metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02723C, Paper
Hongyu Qin, Ao Liu, Kefeng Ouyang, Sheng Chen, Shubing Wei, Yan Huang
A hydrated eutectic colloidal electrolyte based on Mo4/3B2T2 MBene is developed for Zn metal batteries (ZMBs). The terminal groups of MBene accelerate Zn2+ transport and anchor I3−, ensuring ZMBs with remarkable cyclability under high DOD.
